description: Clause-level diff across any two editions of one spec. Defaults: from='latest', to='main' (working draft). Reports status (identical / modified / added / removed / missing-from-both) plus a field-level diff: title, signature, step count, per-step reworded indices, notes, crossrefs. `spec` selects '262' or '402'.

from.description: The 'before' edition. Defaults to the latest stable release.

spec.description: Which TC39 spec to read: '262' (core language, default) or '402' (Internationalization API).

to.description: The 'after' edition. Defaults to the working draft (main).

name: spec.diff
title: Diff spec editions
